energy.title: Energy status
energy.activeConsumptionTip: Measured while the node is awake, which is ~3.6% of each cycle. It isn't the average consumption: duty-cycle corrected it's about 8 mW.

charging.label: Charging
charging.detail: The panel is covering the system's consumption.

surplus.label: Battery full · Solar surplus
surplus.detail: The pack is topped off and the panel is producing more than the station can spend.

discharging.label: Discharging
discharging.detail: No generation available — not enough sunlight. The system is running on the battery.

deficit.label: Deficit
deficit.detail: Solar generation isn't covering the system's current energy consumption.

unknown.label: Measuring…
unknown.detail: About an hour of data is needed to determine the trend.
